sources.title: Kickoff · Vendor migration
sources.text:
Dana: Thanks all. The goal is a clean cutover to Vendor A before the end of the quarter.
Dana: Decision: we go with Vendor A as the primary vendor.
Priya: I'll send the vendor quote to Legal by Wednesday.
Dana: Marcus, can you finish the data processing addendum by next Friday?
Marcus: Yes, I'll have the DPA review done by then.
Dana: I'll schedule the vendor legal call by Friday.
Dana: I'll redline the MSA with Vendor A by October 14.
Sam: I'll draft the cutover runbook by the end of next week.
Sam: Aiko, can you run the SSO integration spike by October 15?
Aiko: Sure, October 15 works.
Jordan: I'll finish the security review of Vendor A by next Monday.
Sam: I'll provision sandbox access by Wednesday.
Jordan: I'll share the access list with Marcus by Monday.
Lena: I'll get the PO raised for Vendor A by Monday the twelfth.
Jordan: I'll sign off the budget by Friday so Priya can move.
Lena: And I'll update the Q4 forecast by October 16.
Dana: Someone needs to tell the current vendor we are not renewing.
Dana: We still have no owner for the post-cutover support rota.

sources.title: Monday standup
sources.text:
Marcus: Morning everyone. Pilot numbers came back and they look great.
Priya: Before we go on, Legal's redline is blocked until the quote lands.
Sam: Runbook is slipping to tomorrow, I'm waiting on sandbox access to the new region.
Aiko: I'll load test the new endpoints by October 20.
Dana: We agreed to freeze the legacy API after cutover.
Lena: I'll set up the invoice schedule by October 23.
Ravi: I can take the compliance checklist for Vendor A, due Monday.
Dana: Ravi, please also send the legal sign-off summary to Priya by Thursday.
Chloe: I'll prepare the vendor onboarding deck for the all-hands by October 9.
Tomás: I'll set up the data export from the legacy system by October 16.
Nia: I'll write the customer notice about the migration window by Tuesday.

sources.title: #vendor-migration thread
sources.text:
Lena: Any update on the budget sign-off? Priya is waiting.
Jordan: Still reviewing, will have it by end of day tomorrow.
Sam: Spun up the sandbox region. Runbook moving to Wednesday.
Priya: Quote needs one more number from finance. I'll get it to Legal Friday.
Dana: Thanks. Also, we decided the cutover window is the weekend of October 17.
Marcus: DPA is blocked on the sub-processor section. Will send tomorrow.
Aiko: SSO spike: starting today.

sources.title: Vendor Migration Plan · comments
sources.text:
Dana: Comment on section 4: Legal needs the vendor's security questionnaire before signing.
Lena: Comment on the forecast table: please add the migration one-off costs.
Sam: Runbook draft v2 attached. Needs a review from Security.

sources.title: Kickoff · Onboarding
sources.text:
Nia: Goal: new hires productive in two weeks instead of five.
Nia: Decision: we run a pilot with the January cohort first.
Dana: I'll approve the pilot budget by Friday.
Chloe: I'll write the week one welcome email sequence by the 20th.
Tomás: I'll set up the laptop provisioning checklist by the 18th.
Lena: I'll map each role to a budget line for equipment by the end of the month.
Ravi: I'll draft the manager checklist for day one.
Priya: I'll write the product one-pager by October 1.
Priya: I'll record the product overview videos by October 20.

sources.title: Design review
sources.text:
Chloe: The buddy program needs an owner before the pilot.
Tomás: I'll build the access request form in the HR portal by October 9.
Aiko: I'll set up the sandbox accounts for new engineers by next Friday.
Nia: Priya, can you review the video scripts by Monday?
Dana: Legal needs to approve the offer-letter wording by October 14.
Nia: We agreed to keep the day-one agenda to three sessions.
Chloe: I'll create the FAQ page for new hires by the 28th.

sources.title: #onboarding thread
sources.text:
Tomás: Laptop shipping vendor can do next-day for the January cohort.
Jordan: I'll review the security training module by October 8.
Ravi: Someone should confirm the pilot cohort size with Finance.
Nia: Feedback survey draft is done, sending Friday.
Sam: I'll add the onboarding checklist to the wiki by Wednesday.

sources.title: Kickoff · Payroll API
sources.text:
Ravi: Target launch is November 2. Decision: we ship the v1 API without bonus runs.
Aiko: I'll finish the tax withholding endpoint by October 2.
Aiko: I'll publish the OpenAPI spec by the 18th.
Sam: I'll own the idempotency keys design.
Marcus: I'll gather last year's audit findings by the 20th.
Marcus: I'll get the compliance sign-off for state tax tables by October 16.
Dana: I'll review the data retention policy with Legal by October 9.
Jordan: I'll complete the vendor risk assessment template by the 22nd.
Chloe: I'll write the QA test plan by next Friday.
Tomás: I'll set up the load test environment by October 5.
Lena: I'll confirm the payroll provider rate card by the 25th.

sources.title: Weekly sync
sources.text:
Ravi: Decision: we use signed webhooks, not polling, for pay run status.
Aiko: I'll implement the webhook retry logic by October 14.
Sam: I'll write the reconciliation job by October 12.
Chloe: I'll run the first regression pass on staging by Monday.
Marcus: I'll get the SOC 2 evidence pack to the auditors by the 15th.
Priya: I'll write the customer-facing API docs by October 13.
Dana: Someone should own the incident runbook for payroll failures.
Nia: I'll coordinate the pilot with two customers by October 20.

sources.title: #payroll-launch thread
sources.text:
Ravi: Heads up, the provider sandbox is down for maintenance until tomorrow.
Tomás: Load test environment is up, running the first baseline.
Marcus: State tax tables for New York are still missing from the provider.
Lena: I'll chase the provider about the New York tax tables today.

sources.title: Launch readiness checklist · comments
sources.text:
Dana: Open item: the penetration test report must be attached before launch.
Aiko: Rate limiting is not defined for the bulk endpoints.
